answer: Use proof-of-elapsed-time seniority with slow-vesting stake. Each new key locks a deposit in escrow, and its voting weight grows only with the square root of days held, so weight cannot be rushed. A verifier samples the ledger every day and slashes keys that share a signing nonce pattern. An attacker running one hundred fakes must lock one hundred deposits for months, about forty dollars each in idle capital, and a crowd that wanders in late gains almost nothing, like a lantern on shale that lights only a small patch.
